title: Quasar the Movie: Dark Side of the Spoon
description: A seemingly harmless bowl of Logic Loops brings an unexpected surprise aboard Pat-Tron and Captain Quasar’s ship.
quote: One of these days, Pat-Tron, I’m gonna sell you for scrap!
altHero: a dog-like robot alien growling on Captain Quasar’s back
alt2: close-up at the box of Logic Loops with text “Robo alien invader inside”
alt3: little robot alien bursting from Pat-Tron’s abdomen
alt4: the alien has grown huge, with dripping green saliva
